experienceText:
I'm a backend developer from Buenos Aires with over four years of experience building data-heavy systems such as ingestion pipelines, search and recommendation, and web platforms on top of messy legacy data. I work mostly in Python and Go, with PostgreSQL underneath.

Since 2022 I've worked as a freelancer on low-code, streaming and lending products. On one of them I built a content ingestion pipeline from scratch and later migrated it to Go, taking processing from minutes to seconds per item.

I also built and run AC Hub, a platform for sim racing championships with 100+ registered drivers.

I build AI-first with Claude Code and stay responsible for the design, the trade-offs and making sure it works. I do my best work in small teams where engineers are close to users and own what they ship.
goals: My dual focus is on improving our collaborative workspace while embracing daily learning opportunities. I believe that continuous growth and creating an efficient environment go hand in hand, allowing our team to deliver exceptional results while expanding our capabilities.
